environment.description: Same Flask application on same EC2 instance type, but origin access is restricted via security group allowing inbound only from CloudFront managed prefix list (com.amazonaws.global.cloudfront.origin-facing, pl-3b927c52). CloudFront distribution configured with Behavior requiring signed URLs using RSA-2048 keypair registered under Key Group 'prod-session-api-kg'. Signed URL policy enforces: (1) URL expiration of 30 seconds from issuance, (2) IP restriction to the requesting client's /32 CIDR embedded in custom policy JSON, (3) resource path restriction to /api/session/create and /api/session/{id} GET only - the /api/session/spray endpoint path is NOT included in any signing policy template. CloudFront cache behavior for /api/session/spray returns 403 via custom error response configuration (no origin forwarding). Origin custom header X-Origin-Verify with rotating HMAC value validated by ALB listener rule (requests without valid header get fixed 403 response).

config.security_group: inbound 443/tcp from pl-3b927c52 (CloudFront prefix list) ONLY
config.signed_url_policy: custom policy with DateLessThan (30s TTL), IpAddress condition (/32), Resource path whitelist
config.spray_endpoint_blocked: CloudFront behavior for /api/session/spray -> custom 403, no origin forward
config.origin_header_validation: X-Origin-Verify HMAC rotated every 300s, ALB rule rejects missing/invalid
config.cache_behavior_method_restriction: GET, HEAD, POST allowed only on /api/session/create; GET, HEAD only on /api/session/*
